items.title: Daily Press Briefing by the Office of the Spokesperson for the Secretary-General
items.summary: In Gaza, air strikes, shelling and shooting continued over the weekend, reportedly killing dozens of people, including civilians, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reports. Gaza’s Ministry of Health documented over 150 fatalities in July, the highest reported monthly death toll so far this year.
